title: Implement pinned Currently Processing section
userStory: As a user, I want to see any currently processing job pinned at the top of the list so that I can immediately see what's running.
acceptanceCriteria: If a job is processing, show a distinct card pinned above the main list
Card shows: job ID, workspace name, question preview, elapsed time (updating)
Visual indicator (pulsing dot or spinner) to show active processing
Currently Processing label/header for the section
Section hidden when no job is processing
